notes: This map is honestly thin: it can draw the mine's surface works site (traced from aerial imagery) and a sourced depth for the underground level, but no fetched source this session locates the specific shaft or the underground laboratory workings within that surface footprint. No detector is placed at site:boulby-mine in this atlas dataset (ZEPLIN and DRIFT, which the laboratory has hosted, are not yet atlas entities), so no entity besides the site itself needs accounting here.
Overpass (which could plausibly find shaft-head buildings or man_made=mineshaft nodes by a bounding-box tag query) was unreachable throughout this session; see the facility worklog.
